ExpansionMain_WallE/WallE_Discussions_Di.en: I know you like EVE a lot. You want to understand about the two of you together... Are you asking what love is?

ExpansionMain_WallE/WallE_Discussions_Di.en: Love is just a feeling. Don't overthink it.

ExpansionMain_WallE/WallE_Discussions_Di.en: I know that answer is confusing, but so is love.

ExpansionMain_WallE/WallE_Discussions_Di.en: Yeah! You're good at friendship. That will be good practice for love.
